entry.title: Generativetober Day 30 - Cookie
entry.content:
Version 1

Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

let content = "";

async function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640, WEBGL);
  background(0);
  stroke(255);
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  content = encoder.encode(content);
}

let t = 0.001;

function snap(byteCoordinate) {
  return 2*map(byteCoordinate, 0, 255, -320, 320);
}

function draw() {
  background(0);
  stroke(255);
  noFill();

  rotateX(PI*t);
  rotateY(PI*t);
  rotateZ(PI*t);
  t += 0.001;

  let lastx = snap(content[0]);
  let lasty = snap(content[1]);
  let lastz = snap(content[2]);
  for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < content.length; i+=3, j++) {
    let x = snap(content[i]);
    let y = snap(content[i+1]);
    let z = snap(content[i+2]);

    let dWhite = dist(content[i], content[i+1], content[i+2], ...white);
    let dCyan = dist(content[i], content[i+1], content[i+2], ...cyan);
    let dMagenta = dist(content[i], content[i+1], content[i+2], ...magenta);

    if (dWhite < dCyan && dWhite < dMagenta) {
      // Note: interestingly none of the line segments are white
      stroke(...white, 200);
    } else if (dCyan < dWhite && dCyan < dMagenta) {
      stroke(...cyan, 200);
    } else {
      stroke(...magenta, 200);
    }
    
    line(
      lastx,
      lasty,
      lastz,
      x,
      y,
      z);
    lastx = snap(content[i]);
    lasty = snap(content[i+1]);
    lastz = snap(content[i+2]);
  }
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("cookie.png");
  }
}

Version 2

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];

      width/10, y+j*h,
      random(0, width), random(y+j*h - 100, y+j*h + 100),

  }

Version 3

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

let content;

async function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);

  const response = await fetch('encrypted-cookie.txt');
  content = await response.bytes();

  const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');
  const t = decoder.decode(content);
  fill(255, 50);
  noStroke();
  textSize(27);
  textWrap(CHAR);
  text(t, 10, 10, 620, 620);
  
  const h = 2;
  const y = 85;
  for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < content.length; i+=3, j++) {
    let dWhite = dist(content[i], content[i+1], content[i+2], ...white);
    let dCyan = dist(content[i], content[i+1], content[i+2], ...cyan);
    let dMagenta = dist(content[i], content[i+1], content[i+2], ...magenta);

    if (dWhite < dCyan && dWhite < dMagenta) {
      fill(...white, 50);
      stroke(...white, 200);
    } else if (dCyan < dWhite && dCyan < dMagenta) {
      fill(...cyan, 50);
      stroke(...cyan, 200);
    } else {
      fill(...magenta, 50);
      stroke(...magenta, 200);
    }
    
    bezier(
      width/12, y+j*h,
      random(0, width), random(y+j*h - 100, y+j*h + 100),
      random(0, width), random(y+j*h - 100, y+j*h + 100),
      width-width/12, y+j*h,
    );
  }

  textSize(16);
  noStroke();
  fill(255, 225);
  text("Cookie", width-60, height - 10);
}

function draw() {
  
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("cookie.png");
  }
}

Discussion

Today I have 3 versions of the prompt "cookie"! I'm going to come clean and admit that I started with versions 2 and 3 shown above before I got to the animated version 3 but since I liked the animation I switched them around to show the animation first. Anyway... I started by downloading my p5js editor session cookie and encrypting it using an ancient pkcs1 rsa private key. Then I took the encrypted output and used byte triplets as RGB values to define colors. I find the structure interesting in that cyan and magenta aren't all mixed together randomly, I can see roughly half the cube is one or the other, why is that the case?

Version 1 (the animated one) is the result of drawing lines from each byte triplet to another where the triplets were used as xyz coordinates in a 3-dimensional space. The color of the line is determined by the distance of the byte triplet coordinate from the white color triplet (255,255,255), this has the effect of "snapping" the color to white, cyan, or magenta based on it's distance. Interestingly I didn't see any white lines, they all ended up closer to magenta or cyan. I suspect this is because all the byte triplets are in the middle of the potential number space?

Version 2 is the result of drawing filled bezier curves with some randomness for each byte triplet and using the triplet to define the actual color. They all turn out a bit muted. I also write the full text of the encrypted cookie in the background.

Version 3 is mostly the same as version 2 but with the colors snapped to white, cyan, and magenta like my other examples.

entry.title: Generativetober Day 29 - Tusk
entry.content:
Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);

  stroke(255);
  noFill();

  for (let i = 1; i < 5; ++i) {
    let h = 85 * i;
    let x = width-i*100-125;
    let y = 185 - i * 10;

    if (i === 3) {
      stroke(magenta);
    } else if (i == 2) {
      stroke(cyan);
    } else {
      stroke(white);
    }
    
    bezier(
      x, y,
      x-100, y+h*0.6,
      x-100, y+h*0.6,
      x, y+h
    );

    bezier(
      x, y,
      x-50, y+h*0.6,
      x-50, y+h*0.6,
      x+100, y+h
    );
  
    line(x+100, y+h, width-40, y+h);
  }

  noStroke();
  fill(255, 150);
  textSize(16);
  text("Tusk", 10, height - 10);
}

function draw() {
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("tusk.png");
  }
}

Discussion

Maybe I'm getting burned out but this prompt said nothing to me. Maybe if I was painting this or drawing it I would feel differently. It evokes a lot of "monster" type vibes but with this computer art project I'm feeling pretty flat on it.

So what I ended up doing was starting with a single pair of bezier curves that looked a bit like a tusk. I turned this into a loop so I could draw a few of them of different sizes shifting left from the right side as it goes. I added lines to the right from each one and it started to feel like merging "tusk" with "claw". I like the story of the development of this piece but not the piece itself. I have trouble imagining some of these prompts from a more abstract perspective, it's easy to get caught up in a literal interpretation.

entry.title: Generativetober Day 28 - Trophy
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

class Atrophy {
  constructor(x, y, c, a, decayRate=1) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.color = c;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.alph = a;
    this.decayRate = decayRate;
  }

  update() {
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    this.x += random(-2,2);

    if (random() < 0.5) {
      this.y += random(0,2);
    } else {
      this.y += random(-2,2);
    }
  }

  show() {
    this.alph -= this.decayRate;
    if (this.alph > 0) {
      stroke(...this.color, this.alph);
      line(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty);
    }
  }
}

let a;
let as = [];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);
  noFill();
  stroke(white);

  for (let i = 1; i < 300; i += i) {
    stroke(...white, i);
    for (let j = 1; j < i; j += 10) {
      circle(width/2+j+random(-2,2), height/2+50+i+random(-2,2), 1);
      circle(width/2-j+random(-2,2), height/2+50+i+random(-2,2), 1);
    }
  }

  stroke(white);
  for (let j = 1; j < 6; j++) {
    let r = j*80;
    let cx = width/2;
    let cy = height/2+50;
    for (let i = PI; i < 2*PI; i += 0.075) {
      let x = r*cos(i) + cx;
      let y = r*sin(i) + cy;
      let c;
      if (j == 1 || j == 2 || j == 3) {
        c = white;
      } else if (j == 4) {
        c = cyan;
      } else {
        c = magenta;
      }
      as.push(new Atrophy(x, y, c, map(j, 1, 4, 50, 255), 1/j+0.2));
    }
  }

  noStroke();
  fill(255, 127);
  textSize(16);
  text("Trophy", 10, height-10);
}

function draw() {
  for (let a of as) {
    a.update();
    a.show();
  }
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("trophy.png");
  }
}

Discussion

"A trophy"... "Atrophy"... Decay.

entry.title: Generativetober Day 27 - Dumb
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function getPerpendicularEndpoint(x, y, lastX, lastY, length, direction = 'left') {
  const dx = lastX - x;
  const dy = lastY - y;
  const dst = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

  // Avoid division by zero if points are identical
  if (dst === 0) return { x, y };

  // Perpendicular unit vector
  let ux, uy;
  if (direction === 'left') {
    ux = -dy / dst;
    uy = dx / dst;
  } else {
    ux = dy / dst;
    uy = -dx / dst;
  }

  return {
    x: x + ux * length,
    y: y + uy * length
  };
}

class Dumbo {
  constructor(x, y, c) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.tx = random(0, 100);
    this.ty = random(9999, 99999);
    this.color = c;
  }

  update() {
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    this.x += map(noise(this.tx), 0, 1, -1, 1);
    this.y += map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, -1, 1);

    if (this.x > width-30 || this.x < 30) {
      this.x = width/2;
    }

    if (this.y > height-30 || this.y < 30) {
      this.y = height/2;
    }

    this.tx += 0.01;
    this.ty += 0.01;
  }

  show() {
    fill(this.color);
    circle(this.x, this.y, 3);

    stroke(this.color);
    noFill();

    let r = random(1, 10);
    let pl = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, r, 'left');
    let pr = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, r, 'right');
    
    bezier(
      this.x, this.y,
      pl.x-5, pl.y+5,
      pl.x-5, pl.y-5,
      this.x, this.y
    );
    
    bezier(
      this.x, this.y,
      pr.x+5, pr.y-5,
      pr.x+5, pr.y+5,
      this.x, this.y
    );
  }
}

let ds = [];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);

  for (let i = 0; i < 50; ++i) {
    ds.push(new Dumbo(random(0, width), random(0, height), random(colors)));
  }
}

function draw() {
  background(0);
  noStroke();

  for (let d of ds) {
    d.update();
    d.show();
  }

  fill(white);
  stroke(white);
  textSize(16);
  text("Dumb", 10, height-10);
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("dumb.png");
  }
}

entry.title: Generativetober Day 26 - Zip
entry.content:
Animated

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function getPerpendicularEndpoint(x, y, lastX, lastY, length, direction = 'ccw') {
  const dx = lastX - x;
  const dy = lastY - y;
  const dst = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

  // Avoid division by zero if points are identical
  if (dst === 0) return { x, y };

  // Perpendicular unit vector
  let ux, uy;
  if (direction === 'ccw') {
    ux = -dy / dst;
    uy = dx / dst;
  } else {
    ux = dy / dst;
    uy = -dx / dst;
  }

  return {
    x: x + ux * length,
    y: y + uy * length
  };
}

class Zipper {
  constructor(x, y) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.lastx = x;
    this.lasty = y;
    this.dirx = random([-1, 1]);
    this.diry = random([-1, 1]);
    this.alph = 255;
    this.dira = -1;
    this.color = white;
  }

  update() {
    this.alph += this.dira;
    stroke(...this.color, this.alph);
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    
    this.x += this.dirx * 5;
    
    this.y += this.diry * 7;

    if (this.x >= width-30 || this.x <= 30) {
      this.dirx *= -1;
      this.x = random(30,width-30);
      this.lastx = this.x;
      this.color = random(colors);
    }
    if (this.y >= height-30 || this.y <= 30) {
      this.diry *= -1;
      this.y = random(30,height-30);
      this.lasty = this.y;
      this.color = random(colors);
    }
    if (this.alph >= 255 || this.alph <= 0) {
      this.dira *= -1;
    }
  }

  show() {
    line(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty);
    
    const p2 = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, 6, 'ccw');
    line(this.x, this.y, p2.x, p2.y);

    const p3 = getPerpendicularEndpoint(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty, 6, 'right');
    line(this.x, this.y, p3.x, p3.y);
  }
}

let z;

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);
  stroke(255);

  z = new Zipper(width/2, height/2);

  noStroke();
  fill(255);
  textSize(16);
  text("Zip", 10, height-10);
}

function draw() {
  z.update();
  z.show();
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("zip.png");
  }
}
